decisions.reason: After surviving the first review cycle and fitting the firm's core architectural door-hardware range, this family is likely seen as meeting or close enough to aspiration to retain while sales mature.
Its distinctive mitred design remains close to the firm's specification-driven capabilities, and absent clear underperformance management would likely keep learning rather than redeploy resources.
Because the multifunctional handle supports the firm's accessibility and integrated-solution strategy, it is likely to be kept unless results now prove clearly below aspiration.
The award-backed collection has strong external validation and brand value, so behavioral and strategic reasons to withdraw it remain very weak.

As a finish option it is easier to prune if uptake disappoints, but it still supports the design-led one-stop portfolio and would usually be retained unless demand falls distinctly short of aspiration.
